entities.name: Human Rights
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The concept that all human beings possess inherent, inalienable rights by virtue of their humanity — including life, liberty, equality, and dignity. Evolving from natural law, Enlightenment philosophy, and abolitionist movements, human rights became codified in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (1948) and now form the moral foundation of international law.
